literal: For the sake of honor, life they will give up; for the sake of life, honor they will not give up, those who cherish honor.
translation: Those who cherish a sense of honor will give up their life for the sake of honor; they will never give up their honor for the sake of life.
modern: நாண உணர்வைப் போற்றி வாழ்பவர்கள், மானத்தைக் காப்பதற்காகத் தம் உயிரையும் விட்டுவிடுவார்கள்; ஆனால், உயிரைக் காப்பதற்காகத் தம் மானத்தை விட்டுவிட மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of a sense of honor (nāṇ) over physical life itself. Those who truly cherish and practice honor will readily sacrifice their lives to preserve their integrity. Conversely, they will never compromise or abandon their honor just to save their own lives. The repetition of the words for honor (nāṇ) and life (uyir) emphasizes the stark choice between the two, showing that for noble minds, honor is far more precious than mere existence.
